mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the battery and then checking the cooler on reserve made the distinction between a prepared circuit and a working supply tangible.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying the backup unit against the measured panel was unproductive: it had no available operation yet, and the result gave no further direction.

surprise.text: The battery combined with the measured panel to produce a reserve estimate, rather than connecting to the switch as I expected. The estimate also accounted for cycling peaks and a margin.

arbitrary.text: The battery-to-panel pairing for an estimate was not obvious to me; I had expected to prepare a physical connection instead.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how the neighborhood handles the directory migration; the practical repairs and their limits were engaging, even if some combinations were hard to anticipate.
